title: Sharks Don't Need Constant Swimming

scenes.text: A great white can travel over a thousand miles in a single day
People think sharks must keep moving forever or they'll suffocate
scenes.label: Sharks must swim nonstop

scenes.text: Most shark species can rest on the ocean floor and pump water over their gills without swimming
scenes.label: Sharks can rest stationary

scenes.text: Even apex predators take nap breaks
scenes.label: Sharks nap too
scenes.sub: They simply hold water to breathe

scenes.text: Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.

description: The idea that sharks must swim nonstop to survive is a classic myth. Learn how these predators actually rest while staying alive. Follow for more mind‑blowing facts!
